method.method_draft: Trace only the solid bonds between non-hydrogen atoms in the transition-state drawing. Count R1-C, C-C up-left, C-C across the top-left/top vertex, C-C across the top to the right side, C-N, and N-R2. Do not count C-H or N-H, and ignore the curved arrows. The total is 6.

推理：按照要求只数非氢原子之间的实线键，忽略弯曲箭头，并排除 C-H 与 N-H 键。可数的非氢键为：R¹-C、左下 C-左上 C、左上 C-顶部 C、顶部 C-右侧 C、右侧 C-N、N-R²，共 6 个。
